name: fibroblast growth factor 3

function.text: FGF3 encodes fibroblast growth factor 3. Annotated molecular activities include growth factor activity and fibroblast growth factor receptor binding. It participates in signal transduction and neurogenesis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to deafness with labyrinthine aplasia, microtia, and microdontia (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Amplification of FGF3 has been reported in human tumors. A regional copy-number gain does not by itself identify the contribution of this gene relative to neighboring co-amplified genes.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Amplification reported by RefSeq; no specific tumor subtype inferred.
